consequence.statement: The default retry policy no longer retries requests on 503 responses; set EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY to false to restore the old behavior (temporary flag).
consequence.remediation: Verify workloads relying on default 503 retries; set EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY=false if needed, knowing the flag will be removed.

original.statement: Istio's default retry policy no longer retries on 503; setting EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY to false reverts this, and the flag will be removed in future releases.

decision.reason: [ev-28c263f19767] says the default retry policy now excludes retries on 503, and that setting EXCLUDE_UNSAFE_503_FROM_DEFAULT_RETRY to false reverts it; the flag exists only for backward compatibility and will be removed in a future release. Requests are still handled. Only the default retry behaviour changes, and the evidence doesn't say anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. That makes behavior-change (review) the right kind, and low severity is reasonable. The proposed statement and remediation match the evidence's wording.
